sourceStack: Documentation only, never used by contracts: the reference build is a single-page app (React 18 + Vite 5, Tailwind v3 with preflight off but almost all styling in plain CSS: src/index.css, src/case.css) with a three.js r169 WebGL canvas (src/engine/cosmos.js + shaders.js) rendering the portrait cosmos. Routes: '/' and /work/<slug>.
sourceNotice: The reference build reconstructs https://vadimcarazan.com, the real, live portfolio of a named designer. The clone uses placeholder content (procedural work art, placeholder name 'Morgan Ellsworth' / studio 'Fernway', its own mark and signature, Instrument Serif in place of the commercial PP Editorial Old Italic, a user-supplied portrait). Much of its UI copy is verbatim from the original. Never reproduce the original's work images, portrait, signature, lettering, logo or copy. See docs/sensitivity-and-licensing.md. Do not publish this repository.
